<b>Silk Cocoons</b> are formed when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is defeated, storing all [[Rosaries]] she held upon her death. Until the Cocoon is retrieved, Hornet's [[Spool Fragment|Spool upgrades]] are disabled, limiting her to 9 [[Silk]]. 

The Cocoon can be broken with one hit from any of Hornet's Needle attacks or [[Silk Skills]], but [[Tools]] simply pass through it (except for the [[Delver's Drill]]). When broken, Hornet collects her lost Rosaries, restores the function of her Spool upgrades, and gains 9 Silk.

Dying while [[Cursed Crest|Cursed]] changes the appearance of the cocoon, wrapping it in ashen vines. Breaking an infested cocoon causes the vines to lash out, dealing 4 hits of [[Needle]] damage to nearby enemies.

Cocoons can be retrieved from anywhere on the map by consuming a [[Silkeater]]. This will act as if Hornet just broke her Cocoon.

== Location ==
The Cocoon spawns at the approximate location<ref group=Note>Each room has several defined locations that a Cocoon can spawn at, with the one nearest to Hornet's death location being used.</ref> of Hornet's most recent death, with its location marked on the [[Map and Quill (Silksong)|Map]]. Only one Cocoon can exist at a time. If Hornet dies before retrieving her Cocoon, a new Cocoon replaces it and all Rosaries stored within the old Cocoon are lost.

== Tactics ==
* Hornet can bounce on her Cocoon by breaking it with a down-strike, allowing her to enter areas that are otherwise inaccessible without mobility upgrades.
* Because collecting the Cocoon restores a full spool of silk, leaving the Cocoon unbroken in a difficult [[Bosses (Silksong)|Boss]] arena allows Hornet to strike it when she needs Silk for healing or Skills, acting as a secondary Silk reserve. Note that this strategy is risky, since it is possible to die to the boss before collecting the Cocoon.
* To remove the risk of losing them, {{R}}Rosaries can be converted into [[Rosary String]]s and [[Rosary Necklace]]s at various merchants or Rosary Stringer machines. However, {{R|20}} are still lost in the transaction, and only 20 of each can be stored.
** Alternatively, {{R}}Rosaries can be converted into {{S}}[[Shard Bundle]]s at various merchants. 
* If the Cocoon is in a location that can be reached but is hard to escape from, it can be retrieved without using a [[Silkeater]] by breaking it then quitting to the main menu. Upon reopening the game, Hornet will be at the last used [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] or checkpoint with all of her {{R}}Rosaries and an intact Silk Spool.

== Trivia ==
* If a cursed cocoon is still in the world when <i>[[Infestation Operation]]</i> is completed, it remains cursed and can still deal damage to enemies.
* When the cocoon breaks, a remnant of Hornet can be seen inside before disintegrating. The sprite for this is called "death_spider_core". It is also mentioned on one of [[Cut_Content_(Silksong)#Gallery|Ari Gibson's sketch]] pages, where it is referred to as "foetal Hornet remnant in cocoon".
